Definition: of uncertain derivation; the emerald or green gem so called:--emerald.
BiblicalUsage: The fourth foundation of the wall of the new Jerusalem is an emerald, set among jasper and sapphire and chalcedony. One stone among twelve, and the city itself is built of such stones.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the foundations preach permanence: the city God builds is laid on precious stone, and it will not crumble.
